headword: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}

definitions.gloss: designated driver service; chauffeur service for drunk drivers
definitions.explanation: A service in Japan where a professional driver drives your car home for you when you have been drinking. Two drivers come — one drives your car and the other follows in a company car.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I called a designated driver service.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{会|かい}のあと{運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I requested a designated driver service after the drinking party.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}を{利用|りよう}すれば、{自分|じぶん}の{車|くるま}で{安全|あんぜん}に{帰|かえ}れる。
examples.english: If you use a designated driver service, you can get home safely in your own car.

notes:
USAGE:
A service unique to Japan where two professional drivers come to your location — one drives your car home while the other follows in a company vehicle. Very common after {飲|の}み{会|かい} (drinking parties), especially in areas without convenient public transportation. Often shortened to {代行|だいこう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call a designated driver service)
- {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (designated driver service company)
- {代行|だいこう}を{頼|たの}む (to request a driver service — shortened form)

RELATED WORDS:
- {飲酒|いんしゅ}{運転|うんてん}: drunk driving
- タクシー: taxi — alternative but you leave your car behind
